ADD IN CH CONTACTS



```{r}

# Step 1: Filter sensor_index to PF_Test_Rig_2024
pf_sensors <- sensor_index %>%
  filter(deployment_id == "PF_Test_Rig_2024")

# Steps 2 Process each sensor
pf_roi4_3axis <- pf_sensors %>%
  pull(file) %>%
  unique() %>%
  #head(10) %>%  # Just first 10 sensors for testing
  map_dfr(function(sensor_name) {
    
    # Step 2: Find the matching delineated file from your list
    delineated_file <- delineated_file_list[grepl(paste0(sensor_name, "_delineated\\.csv$"), delineated_file_list)]
    
    if (length(delineated_file) == 0) {
      warning(paste("Delineated file not found for:", sensor_name))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Step 3: Read delineated and filter to roi4_nadir
    delineated_data <- read_csv(delineated_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(roi == "roi4_nadir")
    
    # Step 4: Extract time_s values for roi4
    # Get min and max times from delineated (with small buffer for precision)
    # Avoids floating-point precision issue
    min_time <- min(delineated_data$time_s) - 0.0001
    max_time <- max(delineated_data$time_s) + 0.0001
    
    # Find the matching full sensor file from your list
    sensor_file <- full_sens_file_list[grepl(paste0(sensor_name, "\\.csv$"), full_sens_file_list)]
    
    if (length(sensor_file) == 0) {
      warning(paste("Sensor file not found for:", sensor_name))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Step 5-6: Extract matching rows and select 3-axis columns, add file and roi
      read_csv(sensor_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(time_s >= min_time & time_s <= max_time) %>%
      select(time_s, higacc_x_g, higacc_y_g, higacc_z_g, higacc_mag_g, inacc_x_ms, inacc_y_ms, inacc_z_ms,	inacc_mag_ms, rot_x_degs,	rot_y_degs,
             rot_z_degs, rot_mag_degs, pressure_kpa
             ) %>%
      mutate(file = sensor_name,
             roi = "roi4_nadir") %>%
      select(file, roi, everything()) 
  })

# Check
head(pf_roi4_3axis)
unique(pf_roi4_3axis$file)
pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  count(file)

# Hmm, not all files same length +1 or -1

pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  count(file) %>%
  filter(!n %in% c(400, 800))
# This is from delineation process
# Remove rows in cases where 401 or 801, duplicate last row in cases where 799

# Standardize row counts: 400 or 800 exactly
pf_roi4_3axis <- pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(n_rows = n()) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    n <- nrow(.x)
    
    if (n == 401) {
      # Remove last row
      slice_head(.x, n = 400)
    } else if (n == 801) {
      # Remove last row
      slice_head(.x, n = 800)
    } else if (n == 399) {
      # Duplicate last row
      bind_rows(.x, slice_tail(.x, n = 1))
    } else if (n == 799) {
      # Duplicate last row
      bind_rows(.x, slice_tail(.x, n = 1))
    } else {
      # Keep as is
      .x
    }
  }) %>%
  select(-n_rows) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify the fix
pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  count(file) %>%
  count(n, name = "n_files")

pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  count(file)

```



```{r}
# Join with pf_meta, accounting for _imp suffix
pf_roi4_3axis <- pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  left_join(
    pf_meta %>%
      mutate(file = str_replace(file, "_imp$", "")) %>%  # Remove _imp suffix
      select(file, treatment, clear_passage, rotate_hub, pres_force, 
             passage_loc, centre_hub_contact, blade_contact, n_contact, 
             c_1_bl, c_1_sl, c_1_bv, c_1_type),
    by = "file"
  )

# Check the result
glimpse(pf_roi4_3axis)

# Verify all files matched
pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  filter(is.na(treatment)) %>%
  distinct(file)

pf_roi4_3axis <- pf_roi4_3axis %>%
  mutate(
    roi = if_else(
      treatment != "400 (50%)",
      "roi4_nadir_200ms",
      "roi4_nadir_400ms"
    )
  )


```

Max HIG time for each roi4 passage

roll back 2 rows, then + 13 forward = acceleration event



```{r}


# Step 1: Get list of files to keep (excluding treatment 400 (50%))
files_to_keep <- pf_roi4_hig_3axis %>%
  filter(treatment != "400 (50%)") %>%
  distinct(file) %>%
  pull(file)

# Step 2: Get max acceleration timestamps, filtered to only those files
max_acc_times <- instrument_index %>%
  filter(roi == "roi4_nadir") %>%
  filter(file %in% files_to_keep) %>%  # Only files we want
  select(file, acc_hig_max.time.) %>%
  filter(!is.na(acc_hig_max.time.))

# Step 3: Extract feature vectors (±15 rows around max, 30 rows total)
pf_max_acc_features <- pf_roi4_hig_3axis %>%
  filter(treatment != "400 (50%)") %>% 
  inner_join(max_acc_times, by = "file") %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  arrange(time_s) %>%
  mutate(
    row_num = row_number(),
    max_row = which.min(abs(time_s - acc_hig_max.time.)),
    total_rows = n()
  ) %>%
  filter(
    max_row >= 16 & max_row <= (total_rows - 14)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    row_num >= (max_row - 15) & 
    row_num <= (max_row + 14)
  ) %>%
  select(-row_num, -max_row, -total_rows, -acc_hig_max.time.) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify: should have 30 rows per file (or 0 if near edges)
feature_counts <- pf_max_acc_features %>%
  count(file)

# Show any files that were excluded due to edge position
excluded_files <- max_acc_times %>%
  anti_join(pf_max_acc_features, by = "file")

cat("Files with complete features:", nrow(feature_counts), "\n")
cat("Files excluded (max too close to edge):", nrow(excluded_files), "\n")

```



```{r}

# Summary of file counts across key variables
pf_features_summary <- pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, treatment, clear_passage, centre_hub_contact, blade_contact, c_1_bl) %>%
  group_by(treatment, clear_passage, centre_hub_contact, blade_contact, c_1_bl) %>%
  summarise(n_files = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(treatment, desc(n_files))

# View the summary
pf_features_summary

# Individual summaries by each variable
pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, treatment) %>%
  count(treatment, name = "n_files")

pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, clear_passage) %>%
  count(clear_passage, name = "n_files")

pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, centre_hub_contact) %>%
  count(centre_hub_contact, name = "n_files")

pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, blade_contact) %>%
  count(blade_contact, name = "n_files")

pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, c_1_bl) %>%
  count(c_1_bl, name = "n_files")

# Cross-tabulation examples
pf_max_acc_features %>%
  distinct(file, treatment, blade_contact) %>%
  count(treatment, blade_contact) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = blade_contact, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)



```

```{r}


pf_max_acc_features_filtered <- pf_max_acc_features %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  filter(
    clear_passage != "No contact" |  # Keep all contact events
    (clear_passage == "No contact" & max(higacc_mag_g, na.rm = TRUE) >= 95)  # Only keep "No contact" if >= 95g
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check results
cat("Total files before filter:", n_distinct(pf_max_acc_features$file), "\n")
cat("Total files after filter:", n_distinct(pf_max_acc_features_filtered$file), "\n")

# Cross-tabulation examples
pf_max_acc_features_filtered %>%
  distinct(file, treatment, blade_contact) %>%
  count(treatment, blade_contact) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = blade_contact, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

n_distinct(pf_max_acc_features_filtered$file)

```


```{r}

write_csv(pf_roi4_3axis, "pf_roi4_3axis.csv") # complete nadir roi (0.2s/0.4s) for all sensors. Total 311
write_csv(pf_max_acc_features, "pf_max_acc_features.csv") #Acceleration vectors (+/- 15 rows from max) for 500 rpm and 400 rpm (100, 70%) data (50% removed). Any vectors too close to boundary removed (17). Total = 241
write_csv(pf_max_acc_features_filtered, "pf_max_acc_features_filtered.csv") #Acceleration vectors (+/- 15 rows from max) for 500 rpm and 400 rpm (100, 70%) data (50% removed). Any vectors too close to boundary removed (17). Filtered so only no contact events => 95g included. Total = 130


```
